image_description: A medium shot of a young musician seated in an orchestra, holding a bassoon. The instrument is dark wood with silver keys, held diagonally across the body. A metal bocal extends from the top. Sheet music stands are visible in front of the musician. Other musicians and instruments (including a marimba or xylophone in the background) are partially visible.
